Comment: I think the puzzle is quite interesting for a reverse. It is not too difficult to find the solution, but it is not obvious either. Moreover, a clash with graphics is always cool.

✅ Approved the contribution.
Comment: Cool graphical puzzle to warm up some string manipulation and pattern recognition.

I liked it. Your solution is actually way simpler than mine. I think I'm a bit too addicted to regex 😅 JavaScript sometimes drive me crazy.
Anyway, looks good to me!

This is a sequel to ASCII Tennis Racket (which is MY contribution, so this shouldn't be considered as copying)
https://www.codingame.com/contribute/view/14755864b02744d63d72901b2d3e4122d33957

I just thought it would be fun to make a reversed version of that clash. Let me know what you think!

Thanks for approving @jonas_melo! I'm glad you liked my clash, and hopefully, my simple solution teaches you the mighty power of simplistic code and that you lose your aura from overthinking solutions (okay now I'm acting weird 😅).
That's fine hahah. When you code in JavaScript for too long, lacking aura becomes a normal thing.
